description: The user-facing summary at the end of the onboard-v0 pipeline. The VERIFY seam: what just happened, what was spawned, what to do next. This is the artifact claude surfaces to the human after the recursive pipeline runs ON them. Naming-discipline: lanes_spawned lists lane slugs only (no Steve names — those precipitate later from audit-streams).

input_refs.description: Reference to the steve-instantiation this report verifies.

report_md.description: Markdown body of the user-facing orientation. ≤2000 chars. Says what onboarding did, lists the Steves spawned, suggests the next action.

lanes_spawned.description: Lane slugs that received a Steve. Mirrors steve-instantiation.sub_sessions[].lane.

suggested_first_action.description: One-line nudge: what should the user do next? E.g., `claude --resume <uuid>` to wake the backend Steve, or `read CLAUDE.md` to understand the genome.
